title: Arrow keys in a tab list must move keyboard focus to the newly selected tab
summary: Pressing ArrowRight selects the next tab and shows its panel, but focus stays on the previous tab, so the next arrow press re-selects the same tab and keyboard users cannot walk the tab list.
consumer: Author-written workspace settings page around the unchanged upstream source at buggyCommit; an import map adds the .js extensions Bootstrap's extensionless source imports need in a browser.
